name: Read
description: Read rows from an existing database table with simple column selection and equality filters.

inputs.name: filters
inputs.description: Optional JSON object of equality filters. Overrides configured filters when connected.

controllers.name: connection
controllers.description: Database connection controller from a database node.

parameters.name: columns
parameters.description: Optional comma-separated columns. Leave empty to return all columns.

parameters.name: schema_name
parameters.description: Optional PostgreSQL schema. Ignored for SQLite.

parameters.name: filters
parameters.description: JSON object of column names to equality filter values.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Number of ordered rows to skip.

parameters.name: order_by
parameters.description: Optional column name used for ascending ordering.
